prompt: The pencils measured (inches): 4, 5, 5, 4, 5, 3. Make a line plot. Put one X for each measurement.
solutionSteps: There are 6 measurements, so the line plot needs 6 X marks.
Stack an X above each length every time it appears: 3: 1 X; 4: 2 X; 5: 3 X.
